receipts.detail: the withdrawal outcome survives teardown in effect: a failed-join row the in-memory reconcile queue never drove to STOPPED is driven terminal by the leader-side reaper, so the withdrawal no longer depends on the destroyed queue (the explicit-choice Solver finding records lease-expiry-plus-reaper as the designed fallback)

lease-expiry is the explicit designed fallback: the reaper complements the lease sweep (never reaping a row with a live lease or live transport) and drives the terminal status the sweep intentionally does not
a stranded joining row with no live lease and no live transport is driven to status=stopped, guarded on the observed joining status
the reaper reaps the stranded row's node_endpoints (inactive) and service_endpoints (unhealthy) rows so leftovers are stale rows, not live routing targets
